newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end off, 1,100 seen out of reach.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end off, 1,100 seen out of reach.

text.p: Austrian shares ended weaker on Thursday on continuing disappointment over the index's failure to pierce resistance at 1,100 at the start of the week and traders said further losses were possible.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips tumbled 6.23 points or 0.58 percent to 1,075.25. Six ATX shares climbed, 15 fell.
"After we failed at 1,100 many buyers retreated," one trader said. "The 1,100 mark is out of reach for the time being."
Traders saw the ATX trapped in a range between 1,070 and 1,090 in the near future.
Technically the index has dropped below support at 1,077 and could even lose another 10 to 15 points.
But traders remained optimistic overall. "I still think we'll see 1,100 again this year," said one dealer.
The November ATX future shed 4.0 points to 1,076.5.
The leading gainer of the session was airport group Flughafen, adding 2.6 schillings to 536.6.
Luxury hosiery maker Wolford was the leading decliner, losing 45 schillings to 1,425.
Brick maker Wienerberger slipped 21 schillings to 1.980 after the group announced a 20 percent decline in nine-month earnings.
Creditanstalt shares barely moved on a rise in the bank's nine-month operating profit.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index fell 2.07 points or 0.5 percent to 412.72.
